description: Send a campaign to ALL of its recipients immediately (one full send, the same path the daily cron uses). The campaign must be active. Honors suppressions and the per-org daily cap, resets the cadence clock (the next scheduled send counts from now), and is guarded against double-fires. Returns { run_id, sent, suppressed, failed }.
name: send_campaign_now

outputSchema.description: Result of an immediate full send to the campaign's recipients, using the same path as the scheduled cron. Only an 'active' campaign can be sent.

run_id.description: Id of the campaign run, for correlating with send history.

suppressed.description: Recipients skipped because they had unsubscribed or were otherwise suppressed.
